scope: 13 coverage cities / 26 final desktop and mobile images, including 3 cities transferred from worker-a before generation
review: Final images reviewed as desktop/mobile pairs, including the independent read-only review of the initial 10 cities. West Island and Nukunonu retain low settlement houses and palms, Nukunonu includes the whole low concrete bridge, and Saint-Denis uses the Barachois cannon promenade. The newly generated scenes use the common dark outlines and pastel travel-illustration palette. Foreground terrain, supporting buildings and foliage may extend to the edge; the identifying landmarks are visible.
correctedIdentities: Pointe aux Canons lighthouse: red middle band and low breakwater
Garapan carillon: mostly solid red shaft and short upper bell chamber
limitations: Stylized destination illustrations, not precise architectural reconstructions; foreground detail and perspective vary between desktop and mobile compositions.
